messages.subject: Re: View large table with renderTable
parts:
You should be able to put the table in a div where you set the css style so that it has scrollbars. Something like this (untested):

div(style = "overflow:auto; width:100%;",
  renderTable("table")
)

-Winston

I would like to send quite large data in renderTable to visualize the data in a Panel but the width of the table is bigger than my screen. Is there any trick to have a horizontal cursor in order to move the table ?

Thanks

Sam
